question: According to the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India (2022-23), which fiber crop is the major producer in Gujarat, Maharashtra and Telangana?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Cotton__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Ministry of Textile, Government of India (2022-23), Cotton is majorly produced in **Gujarat, Maharashtra and Telangana**.
 
• Cotton holds immense significance in India, being one of the primary commercial crops and contributing approximately **25% to the global cotton production**. 
 
• It plays a pivotal role in supporting the livelihoods of around 6 million cotton farmers and engaging 40-50 million people in related activities like cotton processing and trade. 
 
• The Indian Textile Industry is a major consumer of various fibers and yarns, with a usage ratio of around 60:40 for cotton to non-cotton fibers, deviating from the global ratio of 30:70.
 
• Apart from meeting the fundamental need for clothing, cotton significantly contributes to India's net foreign exchange through exports. Often referred to as "**White-Gold**," it is a major export commodity, with raw cotton, yarn, fabric, garments, made-ups, and knitwear being sent to global markets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Acreage under Cotton and Yield:

 
 
• ​India leads the world in cotton acreage, covering 120.69 lakh hectares, which accounts for around 36% of the global cotton cultivation area.
 
• Around 67% of India's cotton is grown in rain-fed areas, while 33% is in irrigated areas.
 
• India ranks 38th in productivity with a yield of 510 kg/ha.
 
 
 
• Production and Consumption of Cotton:
 
 
• ​India is a **major producer** of all four species of cultivated cotton.
 
• Ten major cotton-growing states are grouped into three agro-ecological zones: Northern, Central, and Southern.
 
• India ranks **first globally in cotton production**, contributing 23% of the world's production.
 
• India is the **second-largest consumer of cotton**, using 22% of the world's cotton consumption.
 
 
 
• Import and Export of Cotton:
 
 
• ​India is the **third-largest exporter** of cotton, accounting for 8% of the world's export.
 
• India imports less than 10% of its total cotton consumption to meet specific requirements of the textile industry.
 
 
 
• International Scenario:
 
 
• ​Global cotton production for 2021/22 is forecasted to increase by 9% from the previous season, with consumption estimated at 25.6 million tonnes.
